This page shows the instructor's full example backlog for the fictional thesis. The source is [`backlog.yml`](backlog.yml). Learners build only **E01** and **E08** by hand. The other epics show how the plan continues.

::: {.callout-important}
All people, dates, and records are fictional. The dates are planning estimates. Rule items cite the regulation that applies to the MA Digital Humanities (Major). A student in another programme must use the rules of that programme.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="E08-S1: Issue title and body"}

**Title:** `E08-S1 Document the dataset for a future reuser`

```markdown
> As a future reuser, I need the columns, types, missing values, synthetic origin, version, and licence of the CSV documented, so that I can reuse the data without asking the author.

**Output:** documentation/data-dictionary.qmd
**Owner:** student
**Basis:** Practice

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Every CSV column has a name, a type, a description, and its allowed values.
- [ ] The page explains how missing values appear.
- [ ] The page states that every record is synthetic.
- [ ] The page states the dataset version and the licence.

**Evidence:** Data dictionary page linked in the Issue.

_Fictional thesis. Synthetic data only._
```

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="E08-T2: Issue title and body"}

**Title:** `E08-T2 Decide on rights and access for data and text`

```markdown
**Output:** Decision record on what is public, what is private, and under which licence.
**Owner:** student
**Basis:** Practice

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] The record lists each output with its access level and its licence.
- [ ] The record names the rights of third parties, for example archive restrictions on scans.
- [ ] The record states who decides on library access to the thesis.

**Evidence:** Entry in project-management/decisions.md.

_Fictional thesis. Synthetic data only._
```
